thresholds.definitions: Same as the pilot gate: docs/briefs/st01c-niagara-native-fidelity.md lines 88 and 103-104; mask = max channel > 32 on both images, visible union = max channel > 8 on either image, 512 px, shared ACES presentation (tools/niagara-native-lab/compare-depth.py lines 15-24, compare-color.py lines 28-37). Author decision 2026-10-21, written before the first binding run.

radialGradientExponential.closedForm: ED(t, k) = (t > 1e-5) ? 1 / pow(2.718282, (t*k)^2) : 1 ; x = 1 - length(UVs - CenterPosition) / Radius ; out = InvertDensity ? ED(length(UVs - CenterPosition) / Radius, Density) : 1 - ED(x, Density)
radialGradientExponential.glsl: float x = 1.0 - length(uv - vec2(0.5)) / 0.5; float tk = x * 2.333; float grad = 1.0 - (x > 1e-5 ? 1.0 / pow(2.718282, tk * tk) : 1.0); float opacity = color.a * grad;
radialGradientExponential.glslGeneral: float radialGradientExponential(vec2 uv, vec2 center, float radius, float density, bool invertDensity) { float t = length(uv - center) / radius; if (!invertDensity) t = 1.0 - t; float tk = t * density; float ed = t > 1e-5 ? 1.0 / pow(2.718282, tk * tk) : 1.0; return invertDensity ? ed : 1.0 - ed; }

edgeCases.outsideRadius: length >= Radius gives x <= 0, ED = 1, out = 0 (hard zero at and beyond the radius, continuous at x = 0)
edgeCases.base: pow base is the constant 2.718282 (ExponentialDensity.t3d:98), always positive; PositiveClampedPow(max(base,0), e) cannot see 0 or negative base
edgeCases.radiusZero: length/0 = +inf (length > 0) or NaN (length = 0); x = -inf or NaN; the If node returns the AEqualsB/ALessThanB branch (both 1), out = 0 everywhere
edgeCases.radiusNegative: x = 1 + length/|Radius| >= 1, ED ~ 0, out ~ 1 everywhere (>= 0.9957 at Density 2.333); not reachable with the material default 0.5
edgeCases.ifNode: select(abs(A - B) > 1e-5, select(A >= B, 1/pow(e,(A*k)^2), 1), 1): any t <= 1e-5 or NaN returns 1 (EqualsThreshold 1e-5, MaterialExpressionIf.h:36; HLSLMaterialTranslator.cpp:6614)
edgeCases.descriptionVersusGraph: the ExponentialDensity description (t3d:231) says 0 at depth 0; the graph returns 1 at depth <= 0 and falls to 0 as depth grows; the graph is the source used here
